purpose: Takes a card payment at checkout, marks the order payable, and issues a refund when support asks for one.

reads.note: handed to the browser SDK, which completes the payment against this intent
the order is marked payable only when the intent captures automatically; anything else is routed to the ops review queue
drives which payment buttons the storefront renders; a method the storefront does not know is rendered as a disabled tile
the storefront renders its own method list only when Stripe is not choosing the methods itself
the order moves to paid on `succeeded` and nothing else
written to the order ledger as the amount actually collected
the post-redirect poll; the thank-you page waits on `succeeded`
the support tool shows the refund as issued only on `succeeded`
the refunded amount written back against the order
